methodology.Fees: Borrow interest paid by borrowers on repaid loans, plus loan origination fees and collateral claim fees.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share: the repayment fee (10% of interest) it takes from borrow interest, plus all loan origination fees (25% of interest) and collateral claim fees (0.1% of collateral, excluding NFT/RWA).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's share: the repayment fee (10% of interest) it takes from borrow interest, plus all loan origination fees (25% of interest) and collateral claim fees (0.1% of collateral, excluding NFT/RWA).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 90% of borrow interest is paid to lenders.

Fees.Offerbook Borrow Interest: Total interest paid by borrowers over the full term of repaid loans.
Fees.Offerbook Loan Origination Fees: 25% of estimated interest, charged to the borrower when the loan is created.
Fees.Offerbook Collateral Claim Fees: 0.1% of collateral value, charged when a lender claims collateral after loan maturity (excludes NFT/RWA collateral).

Revenue.Offerbook Collateral Claim Fees: 0.1% of collateral value, charged when a lender claims collateral after loan maturity (excludes NFT/RWA collateral).

ProtocolRevenue.Offerbook Loan Repayment Fees: 10% of interest, deducted from the lender's return when the loan is repaid.
ProtocolRevenue.Offerbook Collateral Claim Fees: 0.1% of collateral value, charged when a lender claims collateral after loan maturity (excludes NFT/RWA collateral).

SupplySideRevenue.Offerbook Borrow Interest To Lenders: 90% of borrow interest is paid to lenders

methodology.Fees: Total swap fees, priced in the valued leg's token. Per-swap fee = amount x (pool.fee / 1e6) where pool.fee is the value live at the swap's block_time (sourced from init_dex plus every update_fee_and_revenue_cut call, window-joined via effective range). Exact-in swaps are valued on the input leg (amount_in call argument), exact-out swaps on the output leg (amount_out call argument). Per-pool token identity comes from the swap calls, with dex_call_init_dex as a fallback for pools that have never traded.
methodology.Revenue: Jupiter's share of the protocol cut: fees x (revenue_cut/1e6) x 50%.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Jupiter's share of the protocol cut: fees x (revenue_cut/1e6) x 50%.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LP share of swap fees plus Fluid's protocol share. LP share = fees x (1 - revenue_cut/1e6). Fluid receives 50% of the protocol cut per Jupiter Lend / Fluid arrangement.

Fees.Jupiter Lend Dex Swap Fees: Total swap fees, priced in the valued leg's token.

Revenue.Jupiter Lend Dex Swap Fees to Protocol: Jupiter's share of the protocol cut: fees x (revenue_cut/1e6) x 50%.

ProtocolRevenue.Jupiter Lend Dex Swap Fees to Protocol: Jupiter's share of the protocol cut: fees x (revenue_cut/1e6) x 50%.

SupplySideRevenue.Jupiter Lend Dex Swap Fees to LPs: LP share of swap fees. LP share = fees x (1 - revenue_cut/1e6).
SupplySideRevenue.Jupiter Lend Dex Swap Fees to Fluid: Fluid's share of the protocol cut: fees x (revenue_cut/1e6) x 50%.
